assertion.statement: The Crossplane 2.0.0 release notes state that the default registry for packages is dropped (feat PR #6548), but the note alone does not say where that default was configured, what its value was, or what now happens to package references that relied on it.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence is only the PR title 'drop default registry for packages'; it does not name where the default registry is configured (Helm value, CLI flag, resource field, or package-manager logic) or which registry it was, so no subject family/identity can be pinned.; applicability: The note does not state which configurations relied on the default registry (e.g. whether package image references could omit the registry, and in which field or setting), so no exposure predicate can be written from this evidence; this is an evidence gap, not a runtime condition.; consequence: The note does not state what happens to an environment that relied on the default registry (e.g. whether package references without a registry are rejected, fail to pull, or must now be fully qualified).
